Meanwhile Deniz Undav (3g, 2a) started vs Paraguay and was subbed off scoreless at 62' (Kai Havertz scored Germany's goal to reach 3g). Lionel Messi (6g in just 200 mins confirmed by FIFA rankings) edges up to 49.5%, Harry Kane holds 6.5%, and Erling Haaland trims slightly to 6% with Brazil now locked as Norway's potential R16 opponent.
